name: google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools
display_name: Google: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Custom Tools
description: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Custom Tools is a separate endpoint of Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, the Pro-tier reasoning model of the Gemini 3 series, tuned for agentic workflows that mix bash with custom tools. Google says it is better at prioritizing user-defined functions, such as file viewing or code search tools, over a general bash tool. Pick it for coding agents built on custom tools; Google notes quality may fluctuate in use cases that do not benefit from such tools, where the standard 3.1 Pro Preview fits better.
